name: Ljubov' i strah
source:
Immerse yourself in a romantic and detective adventure alongside Hikari in the picturesque Japanese town surrounded by the mysterious Ancient Forest. Can you help Hikari solve the crime and navigate the storm of her romantic feelings?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3090800/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在风景如画的日本小镇，周围环绕着神秘的古代森林，与光一起沉浸在浪漫的侦探冒险中。你能帮助光破案并渡过她浪漫感情的风暴吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3090800/]Steam[/url]]
